cards.card_text: They do evil in the sight of the LORD and serve the Baals, false gods.
cards.verse_text: And the Israelites did evil in the sight of the LORD and served the Baals.
cards.snippet: …Israelites did evil in the sight of the LORD and served the Baals.

cards.card_text: They serve the Baals and the Asherahs They stop worshiping anything at all They head back down to Egypt
cards.verse_text: So the Israelites did evil in the sight of the LORD; they forgot the LORD their God and served the Baals and the Asherahs.
cards.snippet: …of the LORD; they forgot the LORD their God and served the Baals and the Asherahs.

cards.card_text: Turn to the Baals Melt down Gideon's ephod Ask Gideon's sons to lead
cards.verse_text: And as soon as Gideon was dead, the Israelites turned and prostituted themselves with the Baals, and they set up Baal-berith as their god.
cards.snippet: …as Gideon was dead, the Israelites turned and prostituted themselves with the Baals, and they set up Baal-berith as their god.

cards.card_text: And again the Israelites do evil in the sight of the LORD, serving the Baals, the Ashtoreths, and the gods of Aram, Sidon, Moab, the Ammonites and the Philistines.
cards.verse_text: They served the Baals, the Ashtoreths, the gods of Aram, Sidon, and Moab, and the gods of the Ammonites and Philistines.
cards.snippet: They served the Baals, the Ashtoreths, the gods of Aram, Sidon, and Moab, and the gods…

cards.card_text: They say, “We have sinned against You, for we have indeed forsaken our God and served the Baals.”
cards.verse_text: Then the Israelites cried out to the LORD, saying, “We have sinned against You, for we have indeed forsaken our God and served the Baals.”
cards.snippet: …against You, for we have indeed forsaken our God and served the Baals.”

cards.card_text: And Israel actually does it: out go the Baals and Ashtoreths, those foreign gods, and they serve only the LORD.
cards.verse_text: So the Israelites put away the Baals and Ashtoreths and served only the LORD.
cards.snippet: So the Israelites put away the Baals and Ashtoreths and served only the LORD.

cards.card_text: They admit they served the Baals and Ashtoreths, false gods, and ask the LORD to deliver them so they can serve Him.
cards.verse_text: Then they cried out to the LORD and said, ‘We have sinned, for we have forsaken the LORD and served the Baals and Ashtoreths.
cards.snippet: …‘We have sinned, for we have forsaken the LORD and served the Baals and Ashtoreths.

cards.verse_text: “I have not troubled Israel,” Elijah replied, “but you and your father’s house have, for you have forsaken the commandments of the LORD and have followed the Baals.
cards.snippet: …you have forsaken the commandments of the LORD and have followed the Baals.

cards.card_text: On the side, King Jehoshaphat also seeks the Baals, false gods.
cards.verse_text: He did not seek the Baals,

cards.card_text: They broke in and used its sacred objects for the Baals They tore down its walls and burned its wooden doors They stripped its gold and carried it off to Egypt
cards.verse_text: For the sons of that wicked woman Athaliah had broken into the house of God and had even used the sacred objects of the house of the LORD for the Baals.
cards.snippet: …used the sacred objects of the house of the LORD for the Baals.

cards.card_text: Cast images of the Baals Carved images of Dagon Stone pillars for Chemosh
cards.verse_text: Instead, he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel and even made cast images of the Baals.
cards.snippet: …of the kings of Israel and even made cast images of the Baals.

cards.card_text: Along with the high places, Manasseh raises up altars for the Baals and makes Asherah poles.
cards.verse_text: For he rebuilt the high places that his father Hezekiah had torn down, and he raised up altars for the Baals and made Asherah poles.
cards.snippet: …father Hezekiah had torn down, and he raised up altars for the Baals and made Asherah poles.

cards.card_text: First up: the altars of the Baals.

cards.card_text: The LORD says the people came up with chasing the Baals all on their own, with nobody teaching them.

cards.card_text: Then the LORD says He'll punish her for the days of the Baals, when she burned incense to them, adorned herself with rings and jewelry, and went after her lovers.
cards.verse_text: I will punish her for the days of the Baals when she burned incense to them, when she adorned herself with rings and jewelry, and went after her lovers.

cards.card_text: The names of the Baals The words of their complaints The songs of their old feasts
cards.verse_text: For I will remove from her lips the names of the Baals; no longer will their names be invoked.
cards.snippet: For I will remove from her lips the names of the Baals; no longer will their names be invoked.

cards.verse_text: They sacrificed to the Baals and burned incense to carved images.
